documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our managed services team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction is the lack of clarity around specific requirements and project ownership, as stated in their note: 'We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.' This indicates a need for further clarification before moving forward.

claims.quote: We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It seems your managed services team is currently exploring options, and there is a need to clarify specific requirements and identify a project owner before proceeding. To ensure we align with your goals, could you please share more details about the workflows you're looking to coordinate or report on? This will help us prepare for a discovery meeting that addresses your needs effectively.
questions: Could you share more details about the workflows you're looking to coordinate or report on?
Who would be the project owner for this initiative?
Are there any specific integration requirements or systems you're currently using that need to be connected?
uncertainties: The lack of clarity around specific requirements and project ownership.
